ExxonMobil's average quarterly total revenue in fiscal 2025 was about $83.06 billion.

Total revenues and other income for full-year 2025 were $332,238 million, according to ExxonMobil's fourth-quarter 2025 earnings release. Dividing by four quarters gives $332,238M ÷ 4 ≈ $83,059.5 million.

This uses total revenues and other income, which includes equity-affiliate income and other income. Sales and other operating revenue alone was $323,905 million for the year. On that narrower measure the quarterly average would be about $80.98 billion.
